release_policy: No new HACS beta while an implementation or evidence-disposition blocker is open. Live candidate acceptance is separate and required for upstream promotion. No stable gate changes.

items.acceptance: Localized GraphQL manufacturer model and independent drive classification
Immediate accepted-command projection, actual response precedence, opposite action, stale/failed/timeout reconciliation
Native charging and window-heating controls, no duplicate primary controls, status mapping evidence
All observed trip fields accessible, native metrics and bounded history; dedup and units validated
Verify endpoint completeness, persistence/backfill policy, no overlap/double-counting; do not claim lifetime history
Explicit alternative range, SOC and odometer sources; correct fuel/electric roles and capture ordering
Boolean oil warning and numeric legacy level separated; verify polarity and migration
Charging profiles and charging/climate/departure timers as normalized native entity attributes
Individual door/window/lock/light states and access aggregate; resolve icons and partial array invalidation
Health warnings, inspection and low-voltage battery evidence; normalize only supported values
Connected-service availability, expiration and disable eligibility as normalized attributes
Unobserved jobs and read-only routes: complete reviewed catalog scan; document context/quota exclusions, no silent unsupported inference
All observed response leaves assigned native state, normalized attribute, metadata or explicit unresolved disposition; resolve truncated schema
Clean install and upgrade; preserve IDs and user choices; verify remaining unprojected/disabled identities
Per capability/API/model evidence; distinguish code tests, HTTP/schema, readback and physical confirmation
Live candidate Q8 validation; representative ICE/BEV and MBB evidence or explicit untested declaration
